what: The antibiotic must now: start empirical IV antibiotics for community-acquired native-valve endocarditis as soon as the three culture sets are drawn, without waiting for identification, susceptibility or TEE (ESC 2023), then switch to benzylpenicillin or ceftriaxone for 4 weeks once S. mutans susceptibility is known. Cultures, TTE and TEE stay required but are out of the stop rule.
reason: No empirical regimen named: the note does not give one and the choice belongs to the endocarditis team.

what: Class SWALLOW (ruling 6): a must 'Screen swallowing at the bedside with a validated tool before any oral food, fluids or oral medication, and keep nil by mouth until the screen is passed (AHA/ASA 2026)' added to 24 ISCH-STR cases that lacked one, with aspiration precautions where the case has dysarthria (and in P04 for the severe MCA syndrome). Not added to M04, RP01, RP03, RS03 (already present) or RM02, RM03 (no neurological deficit).
